definitions.explanation: Someone who has more experience in a group, school, or workplace.

examples.japanese: {先輩|せんぱい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}しました→相談する：02089_soudan⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先輩|せんぱい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{先輩|せんぱい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
{先輩|せんぱい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My senior is very kind and always helps me.

examples.english: My senior colleague taught me how to do the work, and I learned a lot.

notes:
{先輩|せんぱい} refers to someone senior to you in age, experience, or position within a group, school, or workplace.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {先輩|せんぱい}・⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧ relationship is fundamental to Japanese social structure, especially in schools, clubs, and companies.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {先輩|せんぱい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (ask a senior)
- As an address: 〇〇{先輩|せんぱい} (Senior ~, used as a title)
- With possessive: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先輩|せんぱい} (university senior)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {先輩|せんぱい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to consult with a senior
- {先輩|せんぱい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{教|おそ}わる→教わる：02024_osowaru⟧: to learn from a senior

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧: junior (opposite)
- ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧: same year/cohort
